title: Hinomori Shizuku — I'm Not Just Anyone, I'm "Me"〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're looking a lot better than when I talked to you in the classroom.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After all the things you told me, I was finally able to figure out what kind of person I want to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still not sure how the fans are going to feel about my decision...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm still going to try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The first step is to show everyone your determination. And even if something happens, just remember that we're here with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's with the grin?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how you always manage to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I do?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Ever since we first met.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you remember when we were both still idols in training? I was feeling down because of all the rumors about me, but you were always willing to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was just trying to encourage you to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're the one that won the entire audition and I didn't want you moping around just because of some dumb rumors.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. I was still new to everything back then, having a hard time with the dance routines and causing problems for the other girls.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so upset with myself that I cried a lot for not being able to do anything right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I decided to stay behind to keep practicing on my own, you'd come up and yell, No, not like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then you'd stay and practice with me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we did do that too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You even did the same thing when I decided to quit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got so mad that you rushed into the Cheerful * Days theatre on your own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh... Can we just forget about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't think I'll ever forget that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hate the fact that I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! I was just as jealous as you are! Jealous of Shizuku's looks and the fact that she was so special!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I admit I was upset that she was always chosen over me no matter how much effort I put in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But... Open your eyes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku never once took advantage of her position! She always put in the effort to live up to everyone's expectations of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She continued trying to give hope to her fans.
That's why she's so popular. That's why she was chosen as lead!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All we did was start sulking in our own jealousy. She's nothing like us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm never ever forgetting what happened that day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, it also made me realize something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You weren't seeing me as Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days, but you saw me for who I was.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think that was what made me the happiest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's a little late to confess now,
but I was always a fan of yours...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, was is the wrong word. I still am your fan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've been you work so hard since the very beginning. I was actually really proud when you finally made your debut.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I was irritated at the same time that you got so far ahead of me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I really was happy to see all of your hard work slowly start to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So keep working hard, okay?!
As much for the fans as for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh. But don't worry.
We're all in this together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right. You, me, Haruka and Minori...
The four of us together are MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This time, let's make sure to become the idols we want to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The kind of idols who are able to give everyone around them hope for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! That's what MORE MORE JUMP! is all about!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! Shall we make a pinky promise?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Pinky promise? Are we back in elementary school now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, if you insist...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, here goes. Pinky promise...!
